goals.objective: Refactor the Next Move Report PaymentModal UI shell so src/components/payment/PaymentModal.tsx stays below 250 pure LOC by extracting the portal/modal frame and keeping paywall copy, benefits, price panel, promo/email form, and checkout orchestration in separate typed modules. Preserve paid checkout, free promo, Stripe price mismatch pause, tracking, and relationship safety copy. Verify with stability guards, targeted lint/build/tests, and real browser Playwright paywall scenarios. Do not commit.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI/data scenario: run npm run verify:stability and pure-LOC checks to prove PaymentModal.tsx plus extracted payment UI modules are under the 250 pure LOC ceiling and guard copy moved to the right files.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/payment-modal-ui-refactor-20260603/evidence/C001-stability.txt with command output showing verify:stability passed and LOC values.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/payment-modal-ui-refactor-20260603/evidence/C001-stability.txt: npm run verify:stability passed; PaymentModal.tsx pure LOC 244; extracted payment UI modules all <=250 pure LOC | cleanup: lsof -nP -iTCP:3100 -sTCP:LISTEN returned no listener

successCriteria.scenario: Browser scenario: run Playwright Chromium paywall test filtered to Stripe price-contract mismatch and confirm the real paywall disables checkout with the Korean paused label when READING_PRICE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH is returned.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/payment-modal-ui-refactor-20260603/evidence/C002-price-mismatch-playwright.txt with Playwright output showing the mismatch paywall test passed and cleanup receipt for no port 3100 listener.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/payment-modal-ui-refactor-20260603/evidence/C002-price-mismatch-playwright.txt: Chromium Playwright mismatch paywall test passed; checkout stayed paused on READING_PRICE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH with Korean paused label | cleanup: lsof -nP -iTCP:3100 -sTCP:LISTEN returned no listener

successCriteria.scenario: Browser regression scenario: run Playwright Chromium checkout suite proving paid checkout preserves saved reading context and free promo redemption does not create a Stripe checkout request.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/payment-modal-ui-refactor-20260603/evidence/C003-checkout-regression-playwright.txt with Playwright output showing both checkout tests passed and cleanup receipt for no port 3100 listener.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/payment-modal-ui-refactor-20260603/evidence/C003-checkout-regression-playwright.txt: Chromium Playwright checkout suite passed 2 tests; paid checkout preserved saved reading context; free promo did not create a Stripe checkout request | cleanup: lsof -nP -iTCP:3100 -sTCP:LISTEN returned no listener
